rule_text.name: 702.236a
rule_text.rule: Tithe is an ability of some cards. It behaves differently on permanent and nonpermanent cards.

rule_text.name: 702.236b
rule_text.rule: On a permanent card, tithe is a triggered ability. “Tithe” on a permanent means “When this permanent enters, you may tap three other untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control.” Tapping the three permanents is a cost (see rule 118) and may be referred to as paying the permanent's tithe.

rule_text.name: 702.236c
rule_text.rule: On an instant or sorcery card, tithe is a static ability that functions while the spell with tithe is on the stack. “Tithe” on an instant or sorcery spell means “As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may tap three untapped artifacts and/or creatures you control.” Paying an instant or sorcery spell's tithe cost follows the rules for paying additional costs in rules 601.2b and 601.2f–h. An instant or sorcery spell's tithe cost may also simply be referred to as its tithe.

rule_text.name: 702.242a
rule_text.rule: Tether appears on some instants and sorceries. It represents two abilities. The first is a spell ability that functions while the spell with tether is on the stack. The second is a static ability that functions while the card with tether is in the exile zone. “Tether” means “If this spell is represented by a card, you may exile this card tethered to a creature you control” and “When the creature this card is tethered to dies, you may cast this card from exile without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 702.242b
rule_text.rule: The term “tethered” describes the relationship between the card with tether while in the exile zone and the creature chosen when the spell represented by that card resolves.

rule_text.name: 702.242c
rule_text.rule: The card with tether remains tethered to the chosen creature as long as the card with tether remains exiled and the creature remains on the battlefield. The card remains tethered to that object even if it changes controller or stops being a creature, as long as it remains on the battlefield.

rule_text.name: 702.242d
rule_text.rule: If the permanent is put into a graveyard while not a creature, the 'dies' trigger of tether will still trigger.

rule_text.name: 702.242e
